The important distinction is that many solar generators only provide 120V, even when they advertise 2,000–4,000W of power.

If you're looking for a solar generator with a 240V AC outlet, you'll need a larger portable power station that supports 120V/240V split-phase output.

These are useful for powering 240V appliances such as well pumps, electric dryers, HVAC equipment, and certain EV chargers.

One important distinction: many solar generators advertise 240V support, but some require two power stations connected together to produce 240V. Others provide 240V directly from a single unit.
